introHtml: Lat Apparel fleece is a go-to choice for bulk orders because it combines a modern, athletic fit with durable, mid-weight fabric that holds up to frequent washing. Whether you are outfitting a sales team for a winter trade show or supplying a company store with branded pullovers, the smooth face of Lat Apparel fleece takes embroidery and screen printing cleanly. The double-needle stitching and ribbed cuffs add longevity that safety managers and HR directors appreciate when ordering company uniforms or employee rewards.
